title: Stage 1: live arm E (+ B) on the stream -> STOP: owner looks
description:
## Purpose

Stage 1 (live): arm E (labels + explanations, all levers), and arm B (S only, free alongside).

## Scope

600-item stream at p = 0.3; held-out checkpoints after 300 stream items and at end; prequential scoring.

## STOP

**Owner looks** before Stage 2.

## Definition of done

Text-free results committed; one small table (prequential + checkpoints + spend) posted as a comment; 0 unexplained failures; owner's answer recorded.

## Caps

Own ledger with hard ceiling: ~2,000 Jev requests for E (+ shared S zero-shot); `--max-new-requests` = printed bound; circuit breaker on; cumulative epic spend stays under ~$10.
